title: All Of Me
notes: 32 bars, two sixteen-bar halves. Straightforward changes and a good one to start on: every chromatic chord is a secondary dominant resolving down a fourth. Bars 25-26 are written F6 and Fm6; many charts write them Fmaj7 and Fm7, or Fm6 as Bb7. The last bar is plain here and is usually turned around with | Dm7 G7 |.
